rows.label: Respond to an individual rights request

ccpa.note: From receipt of a verifiable consumer request.

lgpd.note: A simplified access reply at once, a complete one within 15 days. Other rights need an immediate reply or reasons.

ukgdpr.note: From the latest of receipt, requested ID, or fee. Access requests pause while awaiting clarification.

fadp.note: Information provided within 30 days as a rule.

pdpa-ar.note: Access requests answered within 10 calendar days.

pipa-kr.note: Access and similar requests within 10 days.

appi.note: No fixed statutory number of days.

nzpa.note: Access requests answered within 20 working days.

kdpa.note: The General Regulations 2021 timeline for responding to a request.

dpdp.note: Response window to be set by rules; not yet fixed in the Act.

gdpr.note: Two further months for complex or numerous requests.

lgpd.note: Small businesses get double the time, unless their processing is high-risk.

ukgdpr.note: Two further months for complex requests.

fadp.note: If 30 days isn't possible, the person must be told how long it will take.

pdpa-ar.note: The 10-day window is the operative rule.

lpdp-uy.note: The 5-day window is the operative rule.

pipa-kr.note: May be extended once with notice to the individual.

nzpa.note: May extend where the request needs consultation or is large.

kdpa.note: Additional time where the request is complex.

rows.label: Notify the regulator of a breach

gdpr.note: From awareness, unless unlikely to be a risk.

ccpa.note: A sample notice to the Attorney General, if over 500 residents are notified. This is California's breach law, not the CCPA.

lgpd.note: ANPD Resolution 15/2024, from awareness; supplement within 20 business days.

pipl.note: No fixed hour threshold; some sectors specify 24 hours.

ukgdpr.note: From awareness, unless unlikely to be a risk.

fadp.note: Notify the FDPIC where there is high risk to the person.

pdpa-ar.note: The 2000 law has no breach-notification rule; AAIP guidance encourages notice.

lpdp-uy.note: Notify the URCDP after becoming aware.

pipa-kr.note: Notify the PIPC of a qualifying breach.

appi.note: Preliminary report promptly; full report within 30 days.

nzpa.note: Notify the Commissioner of a notifiable breach.

popia.note: Notify the Information Regulator after discovery.

kdpa.note: Notify the ODPC within 72 hours of becoming aware.

dpdp.note: Notify the Data Protection Board of India of a breach.

rows.label: Notify affected individuals of a breach

gdpr.note: Where the breach is high risk to individuals.

ccpa.note: From discovery, under California's breach law. Delay is allowed for police or to scope the breach.

lgpd.note: ANPD Resolution 15/2024 also covers notice to affected data subjects.

pipl.note: May be replaced by public announcement if harm is avoided.

ukgdpr.note: Where the breach is high risk to individuals.

fadp.note: Inform the person where needed for their protection, or if the FDPIC asks.

pdpa-ar.note: The 2000 law has no individual-notice rule.

lpdp-uy.note: To people significantly affected. The 72-hour cap applies to the URCDP only.

pipa-kr.note: Notify affected individuals of a qualifying breach.

appi.note: Notify affected individuals, or make a public notice instead.

nzpa.note: Notify affected individuals where the breach is notifiable.

popia.note: Notify affected data subjects after discovery.

kdpa.note: Notify affected individuals where there is a real risk of harm.

dpdp.note: Notify each affected individual of a breach.
